violations.message: J3 (2-pin header) is stranded in the middle-bottom of the board nowhere near an edge, and J2's pin column is inset from the right edge rather than on it; only J1 (RJ45) properly faces outward at the left edge.
In the 2D view C1 and R3 designators overlap each other, the U1 label renders doubled/illegible, J2 and J3 labels sit directly on their pin-1 pads, and Y1/C4/C5 text overlaps component pads.

Roughly half the board (entire bottom region, top-left, and right of J2) is empty copper while all circuitry crowds a center-left band, and J3 is stranded alone mid-board far from any functional group.
C1-C3 are stacked in a single column roughly 4-8mm left of U1 with an intervening pad row between them and the IC body, rather than each cap sitting immediately adjacent to the power pin it serves.
All six SPI/control ratsnest lines from the right-edge header J2 double back across the entire U1 footprint to pads on the IC's left side, so the SPI chain does not read in placement order.

Straight pad-to-pad lines from J1's RX-/RX+/TX pins visibly cross each other on the way to the termination passives, and the J2-to-U1 SPI bundle fans across the IC, forcing avoidable crossover traces.

3d_top shows two long vertical rows of bare pads flanking U1 with no component body on them, and the 2d view shows U1's body outline with these displaced pad strips rather than pads under the body, so the body/footprint correspondence is not clearly satisfied.

The 2d view shows J3 stranded alone mid-board far from any group, J2 isolated at the top-right with long ratsnest runs to U1, overlapping silkscreen in the C1/R3/C2 passive column, and large dead regions in all four corners while the center is congested.

violations.message: In the 2D and 3D-top views the C1/R3/C2 cluster immediately left of U1 is stacked with no visible gap between bodies and crowds U1's left pin row, leaving no assembly clearance.
Pin headers J2 and J3 sit in the board interior far from any edge, so wires must cross the board surface; only the RJ45 J1 reaches the top edge with its opening outward.
The C1/R3/C2 cluster is a ragged overlapping stack rather than an aligned row, and the R1/R2/C3 parts below U1 are bunched with uneven spacing instead of a clean grid.
In the 2D view the C1 and R3 designators overlap each other and R1/R2/C3 run together as one illegible string directly over their parts and pads.
The entire bottom half and left portion of the board are empty while all components are congested in the upper-center band around U1, a clearly disproportionate use of board area.

The ratsnest fan between U1's right pin row and J1's pad rows visibly crosses (lines from upper U1 pins reach the lower 9-12 pad row while lower pins reach pads 1/2), and the six J2-to-U1 lines converge with apparent intersections near U1's upper-left pads, forcing crossover traces.

In 2d the SPI header J2 and power header J3 are stranded far from the U1 PHY cluster with long crossing ratsnest lines, the entire bottom half of the board is empty, and the C1/R3/C2 and R1/R2/C3 reference labels pile on top of each other showing ragged, crowded sub-clusters rather than clean grid-aligned groups.
